minecraft:rabbit: Raw rabbit meat dropped by rabbits. It is edible raw, but cooking it makes it better. It is the base of rabbit stew.
minecraft:cooked_rabbit: Cooked rabbit meat. Cook raw rabbit in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It goes into rabbit stew.
minecraft:rabbit_stew: A hearty stew of cooked rabbit, a carrot, a baked potato and a mushroom in a bowl. It is one of the most filling foods. You keep the bowl after eating.
minecraft:rabbit_foot: A lucky charm rarely dropped by rabbits. It brews potions of leaping. Clerics buy it.
minecraft:rabbit_hide: A small hide dropped by rabbits. Four craft into leather. It is also used for bundles.
minecraft:armor_stand: A stand for displaying armor and heads. Craft it from six sticks and a smooth stone slab. Its pose changes when powered by redstone.
minecraft:iron_horse_armor: Iron armor for horses that can't be crafted. Find it in dungeon, desert pyramid and other chests. It gives a horse moderate protection.
minecraft:golden_horse_armor: Gold armor for horses that can't be crafted. Find it in chests around the world. It protects a little better than leather but less than iron.
minecraft:diamond_horse_armor: Diamond armor for horses, the strongest horse protection. It can't be crafted and is found in chests. Equip it in a horse's armor slot.
minecraft:leather_horse_armor: Leather armor for horses, crafted from seven leather. It gives a little protection. You can dye it any color.
minecraft:lead: A rope for leading animals and other mobs around. Craft four string and a slimeball into two leads. Tie it to a fence post to keep a mob in place.
minecraft:name_tag: A tag for naming a mob. Rename it at an anvil, then use it on a mob; named mobs never despawn. Find it in chests, by fishing or from librarians.
minecraft:command_block_minecart: A minecart carrying a command block that runs its command when it passes over a powered activator rail. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it for moving effects.
minecraft:mutton: Raw mutton dropped by sheep. It is edible raw but better cooked. Cook it into cooked mutton.
minecraft:cooked_mutton: Cooked mutton, a good everyday food. Cook raw mutton in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Sheep killed by fire drop it already cooked.
minecraft:white_banner: A white banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six white wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:orange_banner: A orange banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six orange wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:magenta_banner: A magenta banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six magenta wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:light_blue_banner: A light blue banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six light blue wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:yellow_banner: A yellow banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six yellow wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:lime_banner: A lime banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six lime wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:pink_banner: A pink banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six pink wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:gray_banner: A gray banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six gray wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:light_gray_banner: A light gray banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six light gray wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:cyan_banner: A cyan banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six cyan wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:purple_banner: A purple banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six purple wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:blue_banner: A blue banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six blue wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:brown_banner: A brown banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six brown wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:green_banner: A green banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six green wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:red_banner: A red banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six red wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:black_banner: A black banner for decorating walls or flying as a flag. Craft it from six black wool and a stick. Add patterns at a loom, or put it on a shield to decorate it.
minecraft:end_crystal: A crystal made from glass, an eye of ender and a ghast tear. On the End's pillars they heal the dragon; four on the exit portal summon it again. It explodes violently when hit.
minecraft:chorus_fruit: A fruit from chorus plants in the End. Eating it teleports you to a random nearby spot. Smelt it into popped chorus fruit.
minecraft:popped_chorus_fruit: Chorus fruit cooked in a furnace. It can't be eaten. It crafts into purpur blocks and end rods.
minecraft:torchflower_seeds: Ancient seeds that sniffers dig up. Plant them on farmland to grow a torchflower. Sniffers breed with them.
minecraft:pitcher_pod: An ancient seed pod that sniffers dig up. Plant it on farmland to grow a tall pitcher plant. It takes a few stages to bloom.
minecraft:beetroot: A red root vegetable grown from beetroot seeds. It gives a little food and makes red dye. Six with a bowl make beetroot soup.
minecraft:beetroot_seeds: Seeds for growing beetroots, found in villages and dungeon chests. Plant them on farmland. Chickens can be bred with them.
minecraft:beetroot_soup: A bowl of soup made from six beetroots. It is fairly filling. You keep the bowl after eating.
minecraft:dragon_breath: Purple breath collected in a glass bottle from the Ender Dragon's attack. It turns splash potions into lingering potions. Collect it while the dragon breathes on the portal.
minecraft:splash_potion: A potion you throw, splashing its effect on everything nearby. Brew it by adding gunpowder to a regular potion. Splash potions of weakness help cure zombie villagers.
minecraft:spectral_arrow: An arrow that makes its target glow, visible through walls. Craft four glowstone dust around an arrow for two. It is great for tracking mobs.
minecraft:tipped_arrow: An arrow carrying a potion effect. Craft eight arrows around a lingering potion. The effect lasts a shorter time than drinking the potion.
minecraft:lingering_potion: A thrown potion that leaves a cloud of its effect on the ground. Brew it by adding dragon's breath to a splash potion. It makes tipped arrows.
minecraft:shield: A shield made from six planks and an iron ingot. Hold right-click to block attacks and arrows. Combine it with a banner to decorate it.
minecraft:totem_of_undying: A totem dropped by evokers. Hold it in either hand and it saves you from death once, restoring some health and giving useful effects. It is used up when it activates.
minecraft:shulker_shell: A shell dropped by shulkers in End cities. Two shells and a chest make a shulker box. It is the only way to craft one.
minecraft:iron_nugget: A small piece of iron from smelting iron tools and armor. Nine craft into an iron ingot. It makes lanterns and chains.
minecraft:knowledge_book: A book that teaches you crafting recipes when used. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it to unlock recipes.
minecraft:debug_stick: A tool that changes block states, like the direction of stairs or the age of crops. It can only be obtained with commands. Map makers use it to fine-tune builds.
minecraft:music_disc_13: A music disc with "13" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it, and it turns up in dungeon chests.
minecraft:music_disc_cat: A music disc with "cat" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it, and it turns up in dungeon chests.
minecraft:music_disc_blocks: A music disc with "blocks" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_chirp: A music disc with "chirp" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_creator: A music disc with "Creator" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is a rare reward from ominous vaults in trial chambers.
minecraft:music_disc_creator_music_box: A music disc with "Creator (Music Box)" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found in decorated pots inside trial chambers.
minecraft:music_disc_far: A music disc with "far" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_mall: A music disc with "mall" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_mellohi: A music disc with "mellohi" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_stal: A music disc with "stal" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_strad: A music disc with "strad" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_ward: A music disc with "ward" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_11: A music disc with "11" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. This eerie, broken-sounding track is dropped by creepers killed by a skeleton.
minecraft:music_disc_wait: A music disc with "wait" by C418. Play it in a jukebox. Creepers killed by a skeleton's arrow drop it.
minecraft:music_disc_otherside: A music disc with "otherside" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found in dungeon and stronghold chests.
minecraft:music_disc_relic: A music disc with "Relic" by Aaron Cherof. Play it in a jukebox. It is dug up from suspicious gravel in trail ruins.
minecraft:music_disc_5: A music disc with "5" by Samuel Åberg. Play it in a jukebox. It is crafted from nine disc fragments found in ancient cities.
minecraft:music_disc_pigstep: A music disc with "Pigstep" by Lena Raine. Play it in a jukebox. It is found only in bastion remnant chests.
minecraft:music_disc_precipice: A music disc with "Precipice" by Aaron Cherof. Play it in a jukebox. It is a reward from vaults in trial chambers.
minecraft:disc_fragment_5: A piece of a broken music disc found in ancient city chests. Nine fragments craft into music disc 5. Find them all to hear the eerie track.
minecraft:trident: A three-pronged weapon dropped by drowned. Throw it at targets or use it in melee. It can be enchanted with Loyalty, Riptide or Channeling.
minecraft:phantom_membrane: A membrane dropped by phantoms. It repairs elytra at an anvil. It brews potions of slow falling.
minecraft:nautilus_shell: A shell held by some drowned, caught by fishing or sold by wandering traders. Eight of them and a heart of the sea craft a conduit. It has no other use.
minecraft:heart_of_the_sea: A rare treasure found in buried treasure chests. Craft it with eight nautilus shells into a conduit. Treasure maps from shipwrecks and ocean ruins lead to it.
minecraft:crossbow: A ranged weapon that stays loaded until you fire it. Craft it from sticks, string, an iron ingot and a tripwire hook. It can also shoot firework rockets.
minecraft:suspicious_stew: A stew of a red mushroom, a brown mushroom and a flower in a bowl. Eating it gives a short effect that depends on the flower. Brown mooshrooms give one when fed a flower and milked with a bowl.
minecraft:loom: A workstation for adding patterns to banners. Craft it from two string and two planks. It is the job site of shepherds.
minecraft:flower_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Flower Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and an oxeye daisy. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:creeper_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Creeper Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and a creeper head. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:skull_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Skull Charge" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and a wither skeleton skull. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:mojang_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Thing" design at a loom. Craft it from paper and an enchanted golden apple. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:globe_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Globe" design at a loom. Buy it from master cartographers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:piglin_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Snout" design at a loom. Find it in bastion remnant chests. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:flow_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Flow" design at a loom. Find it in ominous vaults in trial chambers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:guster_banner_pattern: A banner pattern that adds the "Guster" design at a loom. Find it in vaults in trial chambers. The pattern isn't used up, so you can apply it to as many banners as you like.
minecraft:goat_horn: A horn dropped when a goat rams something solid. Use it to play a loud call that can be heard far away. They also turn up in pillager outposts.
minecraft:composter: A bin made from seven wooden slabs. Fill it with plants and food to turn them into bone meal. It is the job site of farmers.
minecraft:barrel: A storage block with 27 slots, crafted from six planks and two wooden slabs. Unlike a chest, it opens even with a block on top. It is the job site of fishermen.
minecraft:smoker: A furnace that cooks food twice as fast, but only food. Craft it from a furnace and four logs. It is the job site of butchers.
minecraft:blast_furnace: A furnace that smelts ores and metal gear twice as fast, but not food. Craft it from a furnace, iron ingots and smooth stone. It is the job site of armorers.
minecraft:cartography_table: A table for copying, zooming and locking maps. Craft it from two paper and four planks. It is the job site of cartographers.
minecraft:fletching_table: A table made from two flint and four planks. It has no use for players yet. It is the job site of fletchers.
minecraft:grindstone: A workstation that repairs items and strips their enchantments, giving back some experience. Craft it from sticks, a stone slab and planks. It is the job site of weaponsmiths.
minecraft:smithing_table: A table for upgrading diamond gear to netherite and adding armor trims. Craft it from two iron ingots and four planks. It is the job site of toolsmiths.
minecraft:stonecutter: A saw that cuts stone blocks into stairs, slabs, walls and more, often more efficiently than crafting. Craft it from three stone and an iron ingot. It is the job site of masons.
minecraft:bell: A golden bell found in village centres. Ringing it gathers villagers inside and makes nearby raiders glow. It can't be crafted.
minecraft:lantern: A hanging lantern made from a torch and eight iron nuggets. It gives as much light as a torch and can hang from chains or sit on blocks. It works great for cosy lighting.
minecraft:soul_lantern: A lantern with a blue soul flame, made from a soul torch and iron nuggets. It is dimmer than a regular lantern. Piglins avoid soul fire.
minecraft:sweet_berries: Berries from sweet berry bushes in taigas. Eat them for a little food or plant them to grow a bush. The bushes scratch anything walking through, and foxes love them.
minecraft:glow_berries: Glowing berries from cave vines in lush caves. Eat them for a little food. Plant them on the underside of a block to grow cave vines.
minecraft:campfire: A campfire that cooks up to four items without fuel. Its smoke rises high, even higher over a hay bale. Without Silk Touch it drops charcoal; craft it from sticks, logs and coal.
minecraft:soul_campfire: A campfire with a blue soul flame, made with soul sand or soul soil. It deals more damage than a regular campfire and cooks food just as well. Piglins avoid it.
minecraft:shroomlight: A glowing block found in the caps of huge nether fungi. It gives off full light. It is a warm-looking light source.
minecraft:honeycomb: Wax collected with shears from a full bee nest or beehive. It waxes copper to stop oxidation and crafts candles and beehives. Put a campfire under the nest first to calm the bees.
minecraft:bee_nest: A natural home for bees, found on trees. When full of honey, collect honeycomb with shears or honey with a bottle. Mine it with Silk Touch to move it with the bees inside.
minecraft:beehive: A crafted home for bees, made from planks and three honeycomb. Bees fill it with honey as they pollinate flowers. Harvest honeycomb with shears or honey with a bottle.
minecraft:honey_bottle: A bottle of honey from a full bee nest or beehive. Drinking it cures poison. Four make a honey block, and one makes three sugar.
minecraft:honeycomb_block: A block of four honeycomb. It is purely decorative. It suits bee-themed builds.
minecraft:lodestone: A block that makes a compass point to it when the compass is used on it. Craft it from chiseled stone bricks and an iron ingot. It works even across long distances in the same dimension.
minecraft:crying_obsidian: Obsidian that weeps purple tears, found in ruined portals and bastions. It can't light a Nether portal. It is needed to craft a respawn anchor.
minecraft:blackstone: A dark stone found in basalt deltas and bastion remnants. It works like cobblestone for stone tools and furnaces. Polish it for a smoother look.
minecraft:blackstone_slab: Half a block of blackstone. Craft three blackstone in a row for six, or use a stonecutter. It suits dark, Nether-style builds.
